evidence_items.title: cx-cmu/AgentRoboCritic-Bench
evidence_items.summary: AgentRoboCritic-Bench AgentRoboCritic-Bench evaluates action-level critics for robot control. It contains 400 actions executed by GPT-6 Astra, each labeled by human annotators. A critic sees the task, the agent's stated local intent and command, and the visual observations around the action. It must judge whether the action achieved its local intent and, if it failed, identify the failure mode. Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26613 Project page:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/cx-cmu/AgentRoboCritic-Bench.

evidence_items.title: zllhhhh/organic3d-benchmark
evidence_items.summary: ORGANIC-3D benchmark Does a 3D CT model's prediction for a finding follow the image evidence for that finding? This benchmark answers it with anatomical interventions on the CT volume, for contrastive encoders and generative VLMs alike, on five public datasets: CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, Merlin, ReXGroundingCT and AbdomenAtlas 3.0. Paper: ORGANIC-3D: Grounding 3D CT Vision Language Models in Organ-Level Image–Text Coupling.
